caption: This is a pencil drawing on paper featuring a large, ornate bowl with a decorative pattern around its exterior surface. The bowl stands on a pedestal base and has two rings attached to each side, possibly as handles. The rim of the bowl is scalloped into an irregular, wave-like pattern with rounded protrusions evenly spaced around the edge. Inside the bowl, three spherical objects are visible, centrally placed and partially embedded within the scalloped rim. At the top left corner of the drawing, there is an inset detail showing a close-up of one of the ring handles and how it is attached to the bowl. At the top right corner, another inset detail shows a small cup or vessel with a handle, depicted at a slight angle to highlight its shape and curvature. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale, with shading to suggest form and texture. At the bottom left, there is a scale indicator, and the artist’s name, "Pearce," is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Monteith Bowl
